patterns.key_values: single-column markdown checklist; rows left-aligned to one margin; done = green rounded-square + white check + strikethrough dimmed text; todo = grey outline box + primary text
borderless monochrome SF Symbols (keyboard toggle, settings gear) trailing, tertiary tint — but embedded in content header row, not an NSToolbar

document-header pattern: large bold page title (date-as-title 'Today') + inline secondary date, baseline-aligned; hairline divider; body is a live-markdown editor showing dimmed ## syntax markers inline

signature_moves: Dimmed inline markdown syntax — ## markers persist in tertiary grey while the heading renders bold (iA Writer / Obsidian live-preview lineage); the note shows its own plain-text bones
Day-as-document title — the date IS the page title ('Today / Friday, July 3'), literalising 'every day, its own page'; no chrome competes with the document
Monochrome-plus-one-status palette — near-total grayscale with a single lime-green reserved exclusively for the done state (Von Restorff)
Triple-duty tertiary grey — one ~#555 token carries date subtitle, syntax markers, and completed text; de-emphasis is the entire hierarchy strategy
defects: Contrast Dilution (over-dim variant) — shared tertiary ~#565656 at 2.27:1, under 4.5:1; active date subtitle is live wayfinding text sitting sub-floor; fix: lift persistent metadata to kit dark-secondary #8A8A8A
Sub-3:1 UI borders — divider 1.34:1 and unchecked checkbox outline below 3:1 (native-soft hairlines, low edge of legibility)
Header-embedded toolbar controls — keyboard/gear icons in the content header rather than an NSToolbar (minor native deviation; menu-bar mirroring unverifiable)

aesthetic.direction: In-app: restrained quiet-editorial-dark — a monochrome dark note surface, Restrained colour strategy (near-zero accent, one green status), hierarchy by de-emphasis. Brand layer (cover backdrop, out of app scope): warm-editorial (sunrise-lake photography + heavy grotesque display paired with an italic serif 'its own page').

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the single lime-green done-checkbox is the only saturated element against a monochrome field; 'completed' is the one thing that pops, used deliberately
Aesthetic-usability / perceptual load (Lavie) — heavy de-emphasis + monochrome yields a low-noise page that reads calm and effortless; the app's core promise realised typographically
Jakob's Law — day-as-page + visible markdown match two trained mental models (paper diary, markdown editors), so the surface needs no explanation

Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — metadata/syntax/completed all pushed to one recessive #555 rather than primaries amplified; but pushed past the 4.5:1 legibility floor (processing-fluency cost on the active date)
Zeigarnik / peak-end — checklist done-state with strikethrough gives visible closure on small wins
